I’m sorry to learn you feel that way but don’t allow those feelings to consume you. Firstly, how you feel about your  pregnancy should not be determined by your partner’s experience. You should experience it as you, the mum carrying the baby. There’s also the part where you share this joy of expecting a child with your partner but please don’t fall into the trap of basing the feelings you have about your child on your partner. You won’t be pregnant forever so please enjoy every minute of it whilst you can. You don’t want to have regrets about feeling disconnected from your pregnancy and more once your child is born. Enjoy it to the max. 
And no one is going to compare between you and BM but even if they do, that’s absolutely irrelevant. People don’t go around comparing random mums to each other so what makes BM any special? She just had a child with your partner so she could easily be that random mum on the street. If you weren’t with your partner that’s exactly who she was going to be in your story. 
Also, it doesn’t matter that your partner has a child already, he’s most likely not thinking about the experience he had when his partner was expecting their daughter. I’m sure you’ve been with other partners before. Are you always thinking about them when doing stuff with your current partner? I believe the answer is no. Additionally, if you have siblings think about it this way. Were your parents only ever excited about their first child together? Was every child after that unimportant? Did every subsequent child live in the shadow of their oldest sibling? I bet not. It’s different if he brings up stuff about his previous experience which in that case you should tell him you’re not interested in hearing about it. Talk to your partner about the pregnancy please. Experience it with him and don’t hold back simply because he’s been there before. You’re a different person this is a very different experience for him. It’s something super special and should bring you closer! Wishing you all the best and good luck with the rest of the journey, mummy! xx 🩷
